distribution.summary: 重庆；江西；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Beaverium magnus from Chongqing, Jiangxi, Yunnan, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010), under the source name Beaverium chujoi, provides additional Taiwan locality evidence; current distribution is unchanged. Lau (2025) provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Current hosts remain Ficus sp., Castanopsis carlesii, and Cassia siamea (= Senna siamea). Beaver & Liu (2010) reports only an undetermined tree for the Beaverium chujoi source entry, which is not promoted as a host taxon.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Beaverium magnus (Niisima, 1910).

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) used Beaverium chujoi as a new combination and noted possible future synonymy with a widespread Beaverium. This historical statement is retained without altering the canonical identity.
